admission.capacityNote: Selection at the gate, on a published 100-point scale split evenly between an online stage and an interview. The online assessment closes on 15 May at 23:59 CET; interviews for international applicants are held online and scheduled as assessments are completed. The number of places is not published.

selection.description: An application letter, scored out of 100 on completeness, English, motivation, industry awareness, structure and the logic of your past activities.
A resume scored out of 100 across general experience, work experience, creativity, computer skills and other activities, 20 points each.
A study-skills questionnaire on motivation, learning strategies and self-regulation, and a prior-knowledge multiple-choice test, each scored 1-10.
An interview scored out of 100 on motivation, professional image, communication, understanding of the programme and English.

requirements.label: A full IB Diploma

officialWording.text: An equivalent of the Dutch diplomas of higher general secondary education (havo) or pre-university level (vwo) is generally required to enrol on a study programme at Breda University of Applied Sciences.

requirements.note: BUas's bar is a havo-OR-vwo equivalent, which is one level below what a Dutch research university needs, and this site cannot state 'a qualification at this level', so it shows a full IB Diploma, which is what this site's readers hold and which certainly clears the bar. If you will hold IB Career-related Programme or Course Results rather than the Diploma, do not read this as a refusal: Nuffic compares the CP Certificate to at least a havo diploma and BUas's own English exemption list names it. Ask BUas directly. On Course Results specifically, BUas's list of comparable educations has two IB rows — the Career-related Certificate against havo and the IB Diploma against vwo — and no row for DP Course Results or an IB Certificate. The list says it is not complete and that an applicant whose qualification is absent should apply and let the admissions officers judge, with Nuffic consulted where there is doubt.
requirements.alternativeRoute: It does not close this one to you, and Breda's own rules open a door before you turn 21. BUas admits on a havo- or vwo-equivalent diploma, and its list of international qualifications gives the IB exactly two entries — the Career-related Certificate against havo, the IB Diploma against vwo — with nothing for Course Results. What it publishes instead is the 21+ assessment, run under article 7.29 of the Dutch Higher Education Act: a computer-based capability test of your mathematical, linguistic and spatial skills, 150 euro, sat on 4 February and 15 April 2027, passed at 5 of 9 points, valid for two years and only at BUas. You apply for the programme through Studielink first — by 1 May at the latest — then answer the extra questions in My Online Application or email studentoffice@buas.nl saying you do not meet the entry requirements; an English test is still required on top of it, and a failed assessment cannot be resat the same year. Normally you must be 21 when the programme starts. The exception is the part worth writing to them about: BUas's own Regeling aanmelding en inschrijving says the Executive Board "kan besluiten de studiekiezer, die in het bezit is van een buiten Nederland afgegeven getuigschrift, deel te laten nemen aan het toelatingsonderzoek, ook indien de leeftijd van 21 jaar nog niet bereikt is" — it may let the holder of a qualification issued outside the Netherlands sit the entrance assessment before 21, and the same applies in special cases where no diploma can be produced. DP Course Results are a document issued outside the Netherlands and Nuffic calls them a transcript rather than a diploma. Nothing says BUas will use that discretion for you — the verb is "kan besluiten" and the decision is the Board's — so put the question to studentoffice@buas.nl in writing and early, name the article, and keep a plan that does not depend on the answer. One further route is national rather than this institution's, and it is the only one that produces the qualification itself instead of an exemption from it: the Dutch staatsexamen vwo. Anyone who registers may sit vwo subjects one at a time with DUO — registration for the 2027 examinations runs from 15 October to 31 December 2026, each subject costs 144 euro with a ceiling of 720 euro a year, and the certificates stay valid for ten years, so the package can be built up and exchanged for a vwo diploma at the end. No age limit applies, which is what makes it different from every colloquium doctum above, and Dutch law lets the College voor Toetsen en Examens grant you ontheffing from individual subjects on the strength of International Baccalaureate results — the one place in Dutch education law where the IB is named. The bill is linguistic: by statute the examinations are sat in Dutch.

alternativeRouteSummary.short: From 21: BUas's own entrance test. Before 21 only if its Board agrees, so ask studentoffice@buas.nl in writing, early.

requirements.label: Documented English proficiency

officialWording.text: You do not need to submit an English test if: [...] You hold an International Baccalaureate (IB) diploma, Career-related Programme Certificate of the IB, US High School diploma, GCE A(S) levels, or European Baccalaureate certificate (English Language 1 or 2).

requirements.note: An unconditional exemption, unlike TU Delft's and RSM's: BUas does not additionally require that English was an examination subject or that the programme was taught in English. Without it, the bar is IELTS Academic 6.0 with 6.0 in speaking, Cambridge 169, TOEFL iBT 80, PTE 61 or LanguageCert 65.

requirements.label: An application letter — part of stage A, which is half the score
requirements.note: A Selection Factor with a published rubric: 20 points for English, 20 for a clear motivation that fits the programme's profile, 20 for showing you have formed a good picture of the industry, 20 for structure, 10 for completeness and 10 for a logical connection to what you have done before.

officialWording.text: STAGE A: 50%. Application letter (max. 100 points): Completeness of the letter 10; English language proficiency 20; [...] Structure of the letter 20; Logical connection with activities carried out in the past 10

requirements.label: A résumé — part of stage A
requirements.note: A Selection Factor scored 20 points each for general experience, work experience, creativity in audiovisual, web or music work, computer skills, and anything else. CAS and creative work outside school genuinely count here. Recorded as kind 'activity' because the requirement model has no 'work-experience' kind, though admission.selection[].type does. The requirement kind enum and the selection type enum are two different vocabularies and neither is a superset of the other.

officialWording.text: Resume (max. 100 points): General experience 20; Work experience 20; Creativity (AV/web/music, etc.) 20; Computer skills 20; Other matters that cannot be related to the above points 20

requirements.label: A study-skills questionnaire and a prior-knowledge test — part of stage A
requirements.note: A Selection Factor with teeth: BUas says "a low overall score may result in non-admission" on the study-skills test and that a low score on any component of the prior-knowledge test "may be decisive in rejecting an applicant".

requirements.label: An interview — stage B, the other half of the score
requirements.note: A Selection Factor, online for international applicants. Scored 20 points each on motivation, professional image, communication and presentation, your picture of the degree, and English.

officialRequirementsText.text: An equivalent of the Dutch diplomas of higher general secondary education (havo) or pre-university level (vwo) is generally required. The selection procedure consists of three phases.

notes: BUas publishes no IB subject requirement for this programme. The admission pages were read on 2026-09-23 and set out only the diploma level and the English requirement; no examination subject is named. This is recorded as checked and absent rather than as unchecked — but 'no subject requirement' is not the same as 'you will get in', because every place here is allocated by selection.

A full IB Diploma is compared by Nuffic to a vwo diploma, and BUas offers a three-year track to applicants whose diploma is comparable to vwo. The standard hbo bachelor recorded on this programme is four years and 240 ECTS; the length of the short track was not established here, so it is not recorded as a credential.
The whole assessment must be finished by 15 May at 23:59 CET, and the interview is scheduled only once it is. Finishing early brings the interview and the decision forward.
This is the most transparently scored admission in this catalogue — BUas publishes the rubric point by point — and not one of those points is an examination grade.
Not established: the number of places.
